purpose: Route Utah companies toward federal customers, certifications, defense buyers, export support, and government-contract readiness—not just grants.

records.name: Utah APEX Accelerator
records.recommended_for: Any Utah company seeking federal, state, local, or defense contracts. This should be the default first routing step before pursuing a specific agency buyer.

records.name: Hill Air Force Base / Ogden Air Logistics Complex Small Business Office
records.recommended_for: A company with an offering relevant to aircraft sustainment, logistics, maintenance/overhaul, engineering, defense manufacturing, or Hill AFB procurement. Engage through APEX first if the company is new to federal contracting.
records.verification_note: The public business guideline is dated January 2023; confirm contact details before an outreach action.

records.name: Marla Trollan
records.organization: U.S. Small Business Administration — Utah District Office
records.title: District Director
records.recommended_for: A Utah small business that needs the federal entry point for SBA programs, certification pathways, capital, or partner referrals.

records.name: Shelby Daiek
records.organization: U.S. Commercial Service Salt Lake City
records.title: Director
records.resource_type: federal export and international market assistance
records.recommended_for: A Utah company looking to export or compete for overseas public-sector business, especially in energy, ICT, transportation, environmental technology, consumer products, or health-related products.

records.name: Daniel Bruner
records.organization: U.S. Commercial Service Salt Lake City
records.title: International Trade Specialist
records.resource_type: federal export and international market assistance
records.recommended_for: A Utah small or mid-sized company that is export-ready and needs practical international-market support.

records.name: Ian Robertson
records.title: Senior Director of Academic and Government Relations
records.resource_type: Utah aerospace, defense, and dual-use ecosystem connector
records.recommended_for: An aerospace, defense, or hard-tech company needing ecosystem introductions across Utah industry, academic, and government partners. 47G is not a government funder or contracting office.

records.name: Gerritt Vander Linden
records.title: VP, Commercial Partnerships & Growth
records.resource_type: Utah aerospace, defense, and dual-use ecosystem connector
records.recommended_for: An established or scaling aerospace/defense company seeking commercial partners, member-network connections, or international business-development support.

records.name: Aaron Griffiths
records.title: Director, Technology & Innovation
records.recommended_for: A technology-oriented Utah small business that needs to become capital- and contract-ready before approaching SBA, APEX, lenders, or federal agencies.

records.name: Michael Finnerty
records.title: State Director
records.recommended_for: A Utah founder needing a broad small-business advisory entry point or a referral to the correct regional SBDC center.

records.name: ERDCWERX via Utah APEX Accelerator
records.organization: U.S. Army Engineer Research and Development Center / Utah APEX
records.recommended_for: A company with a relevant engineering, infrastructure, environmental, materials, or defense technology that may fit an Army innovation challenge or nontraditional contracting vehicle.
records.verification_note: The cited Utah APEX workshop is historical; use APEX to identify current ERDCWERX opportunities.

agent_routing_rules.route: Utah APEX Accelerator first; ask about SAM registration, NAICS codes, capability statement, certifications, target agencies, and bid readiness.

agent_routing_rules.if: Air Force, Hill AFB, sustainment, aerospace manufacturing, logistics, or defense supply chain
agent_routing_rules.route: Utah APEX followed by Hill AFB/OO-ALC Small Business Office.
